notes.title: 😈 Your Soul... I Mean, Your Feedback is Needed! 🔥
notes.content:
[url=https://forms.office.com/e/nnSbRRMeA5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464722/6a8f373f6f01e50f08192f35d756b4ce8c4d8d4f.png[/img][/url]

Minions,

The Demon Inc. Playtest has been running for a few weeks now, and we are pleased with the strategic mischief and high-level scheming you’ve demonstrated so far. Your commitment to our expansion efforts has not gone unnoticed. 💼😈

But even the most sinister empires can improve! To ensure Demon Inc. reaches its full, world-dominating potential, we need your wicked insights. If you haven’t yet submitted your report, please do so via the official feedback form—your thoughts will help us craft an even more diabolical experience!

📝 Submit your performance review here: https://forms.office.com/e/nnSbRRMeA5

Your cooperation is, of course, highly encouraged (and definitely not being monitored by upper management). Keep up the hard work, and stay tuned for further corporate directives.

- The Demon Inc. Management

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283760/Demon_Inc/
